title: Stefon Diggs case: Who is accuser Christopher Blake Griffith?

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mikel Merino's late goal secured Spain's World Cup semifinal place. This victory also matched Argentina's record for the second-longest unbeaten run. Spain now holds a 36-game streak without defeat in international football. They are now one match away from Italy's all-time unbeaten record. Spain will face France in their next crucial semifinal match.
title: Spain equal Argentina's record with 36-game unbeaten run after late Belgium win

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Members of India's ODI squad, including Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma, and Shubman Gill, are likely to begin practicing at Edgbaston for the three-match series. Over 200 kilometres away, the T20I setup will look to avoid yet another 'first'.
title: IND vs ENG: Away from abject T20I showing, India begin preps for ODI series today

author: REMA NAGARAJAN
title: Cancer patient dead, her plea for drug listed 57 times for hearing

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN AND SHALABH
description: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust is seeking a new Chief Executive Officer. A three-member committee will complete the selection process within the next thirty days. Honesty and integrity are foremost criteria for the potential Chief Executive Officer. The chosen individual must foster harmony and command respect from all stakeholders. This appointment will ensure smooth pilgrim facilities and administrative functions.
title: Ram temple trust open to selecting woman CEO, new pick within 30 days

author: JOEL JOSEPH AND NIKHIL SHARMA
description: Four hired hitmen died and one was critically injured during a police encounter. The shooters were sent by gangster Deepak Nandal for extortion. Three police officers sustained bullet injuries in the fierce gunfight. The encounter occurred after the hitmen fired at a businessman's house. This incident marks a significant escalation in extortion crimes in Delhi-NCR.
title: 60 bullets in 2 mins: Plush Gurgaon society turns battlefield; class 11 student among 4 dead

author: SHALABH
description: Four individuals with prior association to the Ram temple were arrested for donation theft. These accused had been involved with temple work before cash counting began. A private agency managed cash, and these volunteers were deputed as counting agents. Significant amounts of cash and jewelry were recovered from the arrested individuals. Police investigations are focusing on this group of four accused.
title: Missing trail: Why Ram temple donation theft may never be fully quantified

author: AMARJEET SINGH
description: Supporters of Narottam Mishra protested the BJP's decision to deny him a ticket. They blocked the Jhansi-Gwalior highway, demanding the party reconsider its candidate choice. This action caused significant traffic disruptions for several hours on Friday evening. The BJP had announced Ashutosh Tiwari as their candidate for the Datia by-election. Local party office bearers also submitted resignations in solidarity with Mishra.
title: 'Stone pelting, highway blockade': Protest erupts after BJP denies leader bypoll ticket

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Recent studies indicate that certain chill entities scattered across our galaxy might actually be artificial constructs created by extraterrestrial life forms. These colossal structures could function as energy collection systems established by intelligent civilizations. Researchers are on the lookout for distinctive thermal emissions and faint visible light from these objects, leveraging the capabilities of the James Webb Space Telescope and Project Hephaistos.
title: Milky Way's coldest objects may not be stars but alien-built Dyson swarms: Study

author: TNN
description: An anaesthetist faces negligence charges after a toddler died following anaesthesia administration. The one-and-a-half-year-old boy received anaesthesia for a lip injury treatment. His condition worsened, and he was moved to another hospital for further care. The child unfortunately passed away while undergoing intensive treatment in the ICU. Hospital authorities have denied the allegations and stated all possible treatment was provided.
title: Kerala: Toddler dies after anaesthesia for lip cut; doctor booked for negligence

author: TNN
description: A missing couple from Hyderabad is now under investigation for financial dealings.  They allegedly collected several crores from multiple investors before their departure.  The couple left their home for Switzerland on June 22, according to reports.  Their daughter filed a missing person's report after they became untraceable.  Police are exploring various angles in this developing financial case.
title: After collecting crores from investors, Hyderabad couple go 'missing' in Switzerland

description: 1983 World Cup winner Madan Lal urged patience with 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi after his struggles in India's T20I series loss to England. He said the youngster must learn to build an innings, adding, "You can't afford to hit every ball." Madan Lal also criticised India's overall performance, saying rebuilding a strong team takes time while success can be quickly undone.
title: 'You can't afford to ... ': 1983 World Cup winner warns Vaibhav Sooryavanshi
